title: The heart opens by dying into the Shabad, not by decorating itself.
summary: Guru describes inward blossoming as the result of self-recognition through Shabad, not as a mood accidentally stumbled into.
lifeApplication: Ask what part of you still wants inspiration without surrender.

source.shortMeaning: Knowing the One within and without opens the heart-lotus.
source.lifeApplication: Let Shabad reveal you, not only soothe you.

evidence.coreClaim: Knowing the One within and without opens the heart-lotus.
evidence.turn: Forgive deeply enough that fear loses its throne.
evidence.practicalImplication: Ask what part of you still wants inspiration without surrender.
